access: Optional: read access for the agent to the project's tracker and wiki (Jira, Confluence or similar) through an MCP server or connector; without it the guide is built from the repository and lists those sources with what to ask for

presentation.name: Prepare an onboarding guide from what the project actually contains
presentation.summary: Asks a newcomer a few questions, then, reading only the sources they confirm, builds a guide to one project: how it is built across its main repositories, how it got here, what is happening now, the shared code to reuse, the commands that run it, where the knowledge lives, which skills fit which task, and a first-week checklist.
benefits: Starts with a short questionnaire on the reader, their first task, the main repositories and the systems they can open, and shapes the guide to the answers
Reads only the repositories, tracker projects and wiki spaces the person confirms, and keeps restricted content out of the shared guide
Traces one real path across the repositories with file references instead of touring every directory
Finds the helpers, macros and fixtures the rest of the code goes through, each with a call site to copy
Summarises how the project got here and what is happening now, dated and taken only from confirmed sources
Looks for MCP servers everywhere they can be configured, plugins included, and proposes read-only connections only where none exists yet
Matches the project's and the reader's own skills to recurring tasks, and ends with a checklist of actions that each have a visible result and the open questions to take to the lead
